{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data (after fixing revenue)
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Filter for customers who converted
converted_customers = sales_df[sales_df['converted'] == 1]

# Compute and print the number of converted customers
num_converted = len(converted_customers)
print(num_converted)

# Compute and print the mean age of converted customers
mean_age_converted = converted_customers['customer_age'].mean()
print(mean_age_converted)"}
